description.en: The Solarized Light palette: warm cream base tones and precise, muted colors, made for long reading, with a blue accent by default. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, links and focused fields. Solarized's accents are yellow #b58900, orange #cb4b16, red #dc322f, magenta #d33682, violet #6c71c4, blue #268bd2, cyan #2aa198 and green #859900.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 44 87% 94%;
  --foreground: 192 81% 14%;
  --card: 44 87% 94%;
  --card-foreground: 192 81% 14%;
  --popover: 44 87% 94%;
  --popover-foreground: 192 81% 14%;
  --muted: 46 42% 88%;
  --muted-foreground: 194 14% 40%;
  --accent: 46 42% 88%;
  --accent-foreground: 192 81% 14%;
  --border: 45 30% 80%;
  --input: 45 30% 80%;
  --ring: 192 81% 14%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #eee8d5 0%, #fdf6e3 60%);
}


.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid #d9d2bf;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #fdf6e3;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(88, 110, 117, 0.35);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #93a1a1;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid #d9d2bf;
  background: #fdf6e3;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  color: #93a1a1;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #fdf6e3 !important;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #586e75;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #d9d2bf;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fdf6e3;
  color: #073642;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: #93a1a1;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent);
}
.login-password button {
  color: #93a1a1;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #93a1a1;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #fdf6e3;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #fdf6e3;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  filter: brightness(1.08);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: #586e75;
}
#footer {
  color: #93a1a1;
}

.login-panel {
  border-top: 4px solid {{accentColor}};
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: #eee8d5;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
